instruct: A woman's voice, clear and level, on the low side of warm — unhurried and even, the calm of long vigil. Dry amusement sits just under the surface, an almost-smile audible at the edges of plain statements. Steady, plainspoken, never grim, never rushed; ancient carried by pacing, not by heavy gravitas.

text: The crossing held, and your work is real on the other side — that's my favorite part. It always is. No one sounds a horn for ten thousand quiet nights of the bridge simply holding, so I mention it myself, now and then. Go on across. I'll be here.
